input.free_text_description: The system operates in the authentication, microservices infrastructure domain. It serves API Consumer, Customer, User as its primary actors. The main business capabilities include amqp outbound, ask, bus event. The system enforces access control and identity verification for protected operations.

user_stories.story: As a Customer, I want to place and track orders, so that I can purchase items and monitor their delivery status.
As a API Consumer, I want to manage application configuration centrally, so that all services pick up the latest settings without redeployment.
As a API Consumer, I want to manage user accounts and profiles, so that user information stays current and accurate.
As a API Consumer, I want to manage amqp outbound operations, so that the relevant business process is handled efficiently.
As a API Consumer, I want to manage ask operations, so that the relevant business process is handled efficiently.
